description: This file defines a class 'GraphicsFromImage' that extends 'Snippet' and contains methods to render various color boxes using PDFsharp's drawing capabilities. It appears to demonstrate drawing CMYK color rectangles on a PDF canvas.

classes.name: GraphicsFromImage
classes.description: A snippet class that renders CMYK color boxes demonstrating color rendering with PDFsharp.

methods.name: GetDeciRect
methods.description: Calculates and returns a rectangle based on an index, for positioning color boxes.

methods.name: RenderSnippet
methods.description: Overrides method to render multiple boxes with different CMYK colors onto the PDF graphics context.
